pages.alt: Tiffin the otter, in a yellow hard hat, waves from the cab of a big red digger with {name} on its side. A yellow banner says “Beep beep, {name}”.

pages.prompt: Lift the lid on the hat box!
pages.alt: Tiffin, in a hard hat and an orange safety vest, pats her hat. An orange hat box with a lid sits on a bench.
pages.altAfter: Tiffin holds her hard hat with both paws. Out of the orange hat box {pops a yellow hard hat|pop yellow hard hats} with {name} on the front.

pages.alt: A big red digger with {name} on its side is asleep at the building site, with Tiffin in the cab and a big horn button to press.
pages.altAfter: Beep! The big red digger with {name} on its side wakes up, its orange light flashing, with Tiffin in the cab.

pages.prompt: Pull the tab to scoop the mud!
after: Up, up... plop! Into Goose's dumper.
pages.alt: Tiffin scoops mud with the big red digger. Goose waits in a blue dumper truck, and a plan on an easel says “{name's} Park”.
pages.altAfter: Up, up… plop! The mud is in Goose's dumper. The plan on the easel says “{name's} Park”.

text: Here comes Frog with the mixer.
pages.prompt: Turn the wheel to mix it up!
pages.alt: Frog's cement mixer has a big orange drum, but it is stuck. Tiffin waits by a new path that still needs filling.
pages.altAfter: Swoosh! The mixer has poured the new path, and {name} is written in the wet cement.

text: One last job... the big slide!
pages.alt: At the new park, a big red slide hangs from a yellow crane with {name} on its side. Tiffin, Goose and Frog wait by the swings.
pages.altAfter: Clunk! The big red slide is on the tower. The yellow crane with {name} on its side looks on.

pages.prompt: Lift the cloth off the sign!
pages.alt: Opening day! Tiffin, Goose, Frog and friends wait at the park gate under bunting that spells {name}. A cloth covers the park sign.
pages.altAfter: The cloth is off! The park sign says “{name's} Park”, and everyone cheers.

text: The digger sleeps. Hats off. Lights low.
Paw in hand, side by side.
pages.alt: Night time. The digger has gone to sleep and Tiffin sleeps in her basket. A yellow hard hat with {name} on it waits on the chair by the lamp.
